title: Deformation theory and the controlling $L_{\infty}$-structure of extended Rota-Baxter algebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce the controlling $L_{\infty}[1]$-algebra of extended Rota-Baxter algebras. As applications, we obtain the cohomology of extended Rota-Baxter algebras and homotopy extended Rota-Baxter algebras. We also study abelian extensions and formal deformations by the lower cohomology group. Lastly, we describe the intrinsic relationship among extended Rota-Baxter algebras, extended Rota-Baxter Lie algebras, and the eigenvalues of the extended Rota-Baxter operator.
